verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://grafana.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated Grafana documentation index, and docs pages are served as raw Markdown via .md URLs (e.g. /docs/grafana/latest/.md and many other .md doc pages), so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs, and evidence of a fuller llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance.
